summary: Single-symbol trade structure analysis. Computes support/resistance from rolling lows/highs, trend score from EMA alignment, ATR-based stops, then produces three risk tiers (conservative / balanced / aggressive) each with entry zone, stop, and target.
core_logic: Identify recent support/resistance via rolling low/high windows.
Score trend bias from EMA(20/50/200) alignment.
Use ATR(14) to size three risk tiers — tight/balanced/wide.
Each tier outputs entry_zone, stop_price, target_price, RR ratio.
Produce a structured trade plan suitable for human review (no execution).
recommended_next_step: Display all three tiers; let user choose which to escalate to a paper-stage StrategySpec.
